title: Was Kurly hacked? Curator and employee data breach, Nov 2026
disclaimer: Made for entertainment using AI. Not endorsed by Kurly, any news outlet, regulator, company, or anyone else named.
size_basis: About 10,900 people, by Kurly's own counts: 10,699 curators, 199 current and former employees and 4 customers. Some curators' bank and ID numbers were included. Revisit if Kurly or a regulator gives new numbers.
who_is_affected: Kurly's 'curators' (people who promote Kurly products on social media for a fee), 199 current and former employees, and 4 ordinary customers. Kurly says it is notifying them. Be wary of calls, texts or emails asking for bank or ID details.

not_known.text: Who the attacker was and how the login credentials were stolen.
How many curators had bank or ID numbers exposed, and whether those were encrypted.
Whether the stolen data has been published or misused.
Whether the privacy regulator has opened an investigation.
